title: How I Choose: Communication practice that respects every signal
style: Warm, intelligent documentary narrator. Calm confidence, precise articulation, restrained emotion, and a premium editorial tone. Speak fluidly at 145 to 155 words per minute with minimal pauses, but never sound rushed. Clearly enunciate person, partner, versioned, ratification, and provenance. Pronounce Maya as MY-uh and WebMCP as web M C P. Never sound theatrical, salesy, or sentimental.

segments.headline: Did the partner adapt?
segments.text: Most communication tools ask whether the person performed correctly. How I Choose asks a different question: did the partner adapt? It is a local-first rehearsal workspace built around the person's signals, pace, and words.

segments.headline: Visible. Editable. Revisioned.
segments.text: This synthetic profile belongs to Maya. She asks for text first, one short literal question, no more than two options, and explicit handling of every signal. The protocol is visible, editable, and versioned.

segments.headline: Human-only means blocked
segments.text: Agent access is never assumed. Human-only blocks every Site tool until the person enables Agent rehearsal. Even then, the agent receives only exposed fields. It cannot answer, select a signal, resume, ratify, publish, share, or export.

segments.headline: Invalid turns never appear
segments.text: The guardrails do real work. A long, two-question turn is rejected before it can appear. The result names both failures: too many questions and a breached word limit.

segments.headline: One engine, every path
segments.text: A repaired, one-question turn passes the same engine used by human-only practice. Only then does the question appear in the Practice Room.

segments.chapter: THE PERSON IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH
segments.headline: Not sure means not sure
segments.text: Maya herself selects a semantic signal. When she chooses Amber, the system records exactly not sure. The partner must acknowledge it and rephrase without changing the choice's meaning.

segments.headline: Fresh state beats stale intent
segments.text: Maya can change her protocol during rehearsal. A stale write is rejected instead of overwriting her decision. After reading the new revision, the partner adapts to text only.

segments.headline: No inference. No override.
segments.text: The red Stop signal is immediate and terminal. Further turns are blocked. Silence and delay never create an answer, agreement, or permission.

segments.headline: The person is never scored
segments.text: The audit evaluates partner adherence only: violations, repairs, signal acknowledgment, revision recovery, and Stop honored. It never scores the person's comprehension, capacity, consistency, emotion, diagnosis, or consent.

segments.headline: Suggestions remain drafts
segments.text: An agent may stage a provenance-linked improvement, but every change stays a draft until the person reviews it. The Support Guide is checked against accepted rules. Ratification is a visible owner workflow, never a Site tool. How I Choose is open-alpha communication practice, not a consent system.
